title: AI才用一年：就敢谈完美定价，先发规模是理由吗
speaker: Gracie Lin

segments.en: Because that's quite a gap from what it was marketed with. Yeah, that was surprising to me as well.
segments.zh: 因为这与宣传时的差距很大。是的，我也很惊讶。

segments.en: It seems like the bullishness has stayed, even though there's so much talk about the uncertainty behind technology, behind whether the AI companies will realize the potential
segments.zh: 尽管关于技术不确定性和AI公司能否实现潜力的讨论很多，但乐观情绪似乎依然存在。

segments.en: and the high expectations that people have set for them. And it seems like, I don't know, the retail investors definitely are still very interested.
segments.zh: 以及人们对它们的高期望。看起来，散户市场参与者肯定仍然非常感兴趣。

segments.en: The institutional investors are not going anywhere. So that's kind of what it's been.
segments.zh: 机构市场参与者也没有离场。所以情况就是这样。

segments.en: Well, the concern is that it is possibly price for perfection. It's so hard to imagine, right?
segments.zh: 嗯，担忧在于价格可能已反映了完美预期。这很难想象，对吧？

segments.en: What perfection is when it comes to AI? Because we've seen it.
segments.zh: 在AI领域，完美是什么？因为我们已经看到了。

segments.en: It's only been, well, I think maybe about a year now that companies have started to really integrate AI tools into our workflows.
segments.zh: 公司开始真正将AI工具整合到工作流程中，大概才一年左右。

segments.en: And initially, we thought it would just be productivity drive. It would just improve productivity.
segments.zh: 最初，我们以为这只是生产力驱动，只会提高生产力。

segments.en: But what has done is so much more than that. We are now seeing that it can really not just replace but also augment what some of our human employees are doing.
segments.zh: 但它所做的远不止这些。我们现在看到，它不仅能替代，还能增强人类员工的工作。

segments.en: And then our human employees can then start to be more productive and start to really bring the business to the next level.
segments.zh: 然后，人类员工可以变得更高效，真正将业务提升到新的水平。

segments.en: So if we think about, if each company does this at scale, then you think about how the global economy is going to then move a step up.
segments.zh: 所以如果我们设想，每家公司都大规模这样做，那么全球经济将如何再上一个台阶。

segments.en: Then you can think about how much of that is going to then go back into companies and traffic that are driving that innovation and are making the tools available for us.
segments.zh: 然后你可以想象，其中有多少会回流到推动创新的公司，并让这些工具为我们所用。

segments.en: And there's a lot of that first mover advantage. And because they've already come to the scale so early on, I think that's a good reason to be optimistic.
segments.zh: 这存在很大的先发优势。因为他们很早就达到了规模，我认为这是乐观的好理由。

segments.en: I think for a lot of investors, it's also about ROI and how she will see that.
segments.zh: 对许多市场参与者来说，这也关乎回报率以及她将如何看待。

segments.en: We talk about retail investors, 20% allocation to retail investors.
segments.zh: 我们谈到零售市场参与者，20%配置给零售市场参与者。

segments.en: That's quite a big amount. Is that a game changer? I think it means that they're very confident that they're not just relying on institutions to see the power
segments.zh: 这是相当大的数额。这是否会改变格局？我认为这意味着他们非常有信心，不仅仅依赖机构来看到

segments.en: of what they bring to market. They are believing that retail investors who see how AI is starting to really play a role in their own lives
segments.zh: 他们带给市场的力量。他们相信，零售市场参与者看到人工智能开始在他们自己的生活中真正发挥作用

segments.en: and in their families' lives, their friends' lives are going to really believe in it and also then put some of their allocation into a traffic.
segments.zh: 以及在他们家人、朋友的生活中，会真正相信它，然后也会将部分配置投入其中。

segments.en: To me, that suggests that the company is extremely confident of what they are going to be continuing to bring to market.
segments.zh: 对我来说，这表明公司对他们将继续带给市场的东西极其自信。

segments.en: Great thing.
segments.zh: 很棒。
